evidence.title: GitHub - supabase/mcp: Connect Supabase to your AI assistants · GitHub

name: Supabase MCP Server
summary: MCP server that connects Supabase projects to AI assistants for managing tables, config and data.
description: A Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants work directly on a Supabase project: managing tables, fetching config, running SQL and querying data, with OAuth 2.1 sign-in. Distributed as npm packages (@supabase/mcp-server-supabase and @supabase/mcp-server-postgrest), a remote endpoint, a local CLI URL and a self-hosting handler.
contains: OAuth 2.1 login; read-only and project-scoped tool filtering
createToolSchemas() for the Vercel AI SDK MCP client
